MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 5

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 15
   C. 30
   D. 22

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 21

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 19
   C. 60
   D. 38

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
